scope: Desktop production build in Meta IWER. Simulated hands and history. No physical Quest or participant verification.

checks: Primary desktop input enters active XR and reaches a non-recording handover with real sample-derived per-finger shares
The scene viewport stays above the controls, with no overlay on the app
Watch, Perform and Rehearse inputs change the actual render controls and retain finite poses
Progress includes the earlier pose and remains inspectable; Pause freezes the flow and Resume continues it
Changing chapters while paused resumes safely and removes the Progress ghost
Hand Print measures the simulated actor through the live path and preserves the 21 prepared records
Replay can be interrupted; Full app opens the complete later-session path
The GPU-independent explanation loads real model data; visit and finger controls update the values and chart
Narrow desktop layout keeps its scene and controls separate without horizontal overflow
Offline XR handover, actual mode input and Progress work under /Understudy/
Offline explanation, keyboard-compatible model controls, previews and self-hosted fonts work under /Understudy/

limits: Desktop timings and render counts do not establish 60 fps, tracking accuracy, comfort or anchor persistence on Quest hardware.
